subject: Discovery recap — propose demo deep‑dive & schedule evaluation kickoff
body:
From: Karthik Iyer <karthik@redwoodinference.com>
To: Elaine Park <elaine@medexa.ai>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben@redwoodinference.com>, Monica Patel <monica@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Tue, 14 Sep 2027 15:02:00 -0700
Subject: Discovery recap — propose demo deep‑dive & schedule evaluation kickoff

Elaine — thanks again for a productive discovery call today. Quick recap and proposed next steps so we can lock calendars: 

Recap (high level):
- Primary objective: reduce time-to-insight across patient cohorts (extract structured findings from visit notes + rerank for care pathway suggestions).
- Key success signals: precision/recall on named-entity extraction >= 88% on your sample set; end-to-end latency < 250ms p95 for 512-token workload; embedding-based similarity recall >= 90 for top-5.
- Security/compliance: Quantiva will need SOC2 evidence + audit log retention details before formal procurement.

Proposed next steps:
1) Technical deep-dive / architecture review (90 min) — propose either Thu 9/16 10:00–11:30 PT or Fri 9/17 13:00–14:30 PT. Ben will lead runtime/observability; Monica will run prompt/eval discussion.
2) Eval kickoff (trial plan) — 30–45 min to agree success criteria, trial mechanics, and sample prompts. Suggested window the week of 9/20.

I attached a draft trial charter and a mutual action plan to get us started (see attachments). If you can confirm which of the two deep‑dive slots works for your team, we’ll send a calendar invite and a short pre-work checklist (sample dataset, a few representative prompts, and a security contact).

Thanks,
Karthik
Senior Account Executive | Redwood Inference
karthik@redwoodinference.com | +1 (415) 555-0198
[Attachment: trial-charter_QH_v1.docx (docx)]

-----Original Message-----
From: Elaine Park <elaine@medexa.ai>
To: Karthik Iyer <karthik@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Rajiv Mehra <rajiv@quantiva.com>
Date: Tue, 14 Sep 2027 17:10:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Discovery recap — propose demo deep‑dive & schedule evaluation kickoff

Thanks Karthik — great summary and aligned on success signals. Quick notes: 
- We prefer to split the technical deep-dive into two shorter sessions (infra/latency + security, and prompts/quality) because stakeholders (Rajiv and our ML ops lead) will only be available for parts of the session. Would Thu 9/16 10:00–10:45 PT for infra/security and Fri 9/17 13:00–13:45 PT for prompts/quality work?
- Eval kickoff: week of 9/20 works for a short sync. We’d like the kickoff to include an explicit pass/fail checklist for the prompt set.

I copied Rajiv; he can confirm his availability for the two halves. I’ll also route a copy of our compliance requirements to your security contact if needed.

—Elaine
Head of Product | Medexa
elaine@medexa.ai

-----Original Message-----
From: Ben Carter <ben@redwoodinference.com>
To: Karthik Iyer <karthik@redwoodinference.com>, Elaine Park <elaine@medexa.ai>
Cc: Monica Patel <monica@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Wed, 15 Sep 2027 09:05:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Discovery recap — propose demo deep‑dive & schedule evaluation kickoff

Elaine — splitting into two focused 45min blocks is totally doable and probably better for your stakeholders. Proposed owners and agenda slices below: 

Session A — Infra & Security (45 min) — Thu 9/16 10:00–10:45 PT
- Owner: Ben Carter (runtime, capacity planning, latency SLOs)
- Agenda: 1) runtime architecture & how we hit p95 targets, 2) autoscaling/burst behavior for spikes, 3) security controls (networking, KMS/HSM basics, audit logs)

Session B — Prompts, Evals & Quality (45 min) — Fri 9/17 13:00–13:45 PT
- Owner: Monica Patel (prompt evaluation, metrics, scoring, embedding and rerank profiles)
- Agenda: 1) sample prompt workflows, 2) evaluation metric baseline + pass/fail thresholds, 3) prompt set handoff and tooling (we’ll demo our eval harness)

Prep ask (short):
- Can Medexa share 200–300 de‑identified example documents (or a small representative sample) ahead of Session B? That will let Monica put together a baseline prompt/metric run.
- For Session A, if you have an SSO contact or a short list of compliance items we should expect, please send to security@redwoodinference.com.

I updated the trial charter with the split-session agenda and a first draft of success criteria; attached as v1.1. I’ll also create a Calendly for the exact invite if Karthik wants to push the links.

Cheers,
Ben Carter
Solutions Architect | Redwood Inference
ben@redwoodinference.com
[Attachment: trial-charter_QH_v1.1.docx (docx)]

-----Original Message-----
From: Karthik Iyer <karthik@redwoodinference.com>
To: Elaine Park <elaine@medexa.ai>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben@redwoodinference.com>, Monica Patel <monica@redwoodinference.com>, Rajiv Mehra <rajiv@quantiva.com>
Date: Thu, 16 Sep 2027 10:12:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Discovery recap — propose demo deep‑dive & schedule evaluation kickoff

Elaine / Rajiv — thanks for the quick replies and for confirming the split. I booked both 45min sessions and shared the invites (links below). Please accept when you have a moment.

Confirmed sessions (calendar invites sent):
- Thu, 16 Sep 2027 • 10:00–10:45 PT — Infra & Security deep-dive (Ben lead) — https://calendly.com/redwood-karthik/tech-deep-dive?event=infra-security
- Fri, 17 Sep 2027 • 13:00–13:45 PT — Prompts & Eval deep-dive (Monica lead) — https://calendly.com/redwood-karthik/tech-deep-dive?event=prompts-evals

Eval kickoff (proposed): Mon, 20 Sep 2027 • 11:00–11:30 PT — short alignment to finalize trial mechanics and pass/fail checklist. Invite will follow once you confirm.

Draft trial plan summary (high level):
- Duration: 3 weeks sandbox trial with a fixed set of sample prompts and an evaluation harness we’ll run.
- Responsibilities: Medexa to provide sample payloads + security contact; Redwood to provide trial environment, baseline evals, and weekly syncs.
- Pass criteria (examples): NER F1 >= 0.88; rerank top-5 recall >= 0.90; end-to-end p95 latency < 250ms for 512 tokens.

Next steps:
- Elaine/Rajiv: confirm trial kickoff slot (Mon 9/20 11:00 PT) and attach sample dataset to the shared Drive folder (link below) or indicate ETA.
- Medexa security: send compliance questionnaire to security@redwoodinference.com.
- Karthik/Ben/Monica: we’ll finalize the trial charter and upload v1.1 (attached) to the shared Drive.

HubSpot deal: https://hub.redwoodinference.com/deals/QH-2027-0821
Shared folder: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1QHtrial

Thanks — looking forward to the sessions.
Karthik
Senior Account Executive | Redwood Inference
karthik@redwoodinference.com
